Package com.hiface.sdk.verification

Interface FaceVerificationApi

public interface FaceVerificationApi
Image similarity comparison and dynamic camera 1:1 verification, obtained through HiFaceSdk.verification().

The SDK supplies the implementation; applications do not implement or construct this interface.

  • Method Details

    • compareBlocking

      @NonNull @WorkerThread HiFaceResult<java.lang.Float> compareBlocking(@NonNull android.graphics.Bitmap faceImage1, @NonNull android.graphics.Bitmap faceImage2)
      Synchronously extract the largest face in each of two images and return a similarity in [0,1]. Call on a host worker thread. Both dimensions of each selected face must be at least 100 px. If features are already available, prefer compare(String, String). Do not replace or recycle the Bitmaps until the call returns.

    • compare

      @NonNull HiFaceResult<java.lang.Float> compare(@NonNull java.lang.String faceFeature1, @NonNull java.lang.String faceFeature2)
      Compare two face-feature strings and return similarity in [0,1], without extracting features again or loading models. Strings can come from Bitmap extraction, camera capture, or the face library. Invalid encoding returns INVALID_ARGUMENT. The first call waits for offline authorization-platform preparation without requiring a separate file or explicit initialization. A worker thread is recommended.

    • startCameraVerification

      @NonNull FaceRequest startCameraVerification(@NonNull FaceVerificationConfig config, @NonNull FaceFlowListener listener)
      Start one dynamic camera-verification flow. The reference feature is bound in its settings. Complete any configured action challenges first. When FaceVerificationConfig.Builder.enableSilentLiveness(boolean) is enabled, passive liveness and dynamic 1:1 verification run on the same final frames, and liveness must pass for verification to succeed. Otherwise the flow performs identity-only dynamic 1:1 verification. Listener methods are dispatched asynchronously on the main thread. Retain the returned request only when early cancellation is needed, such as leaving a page.
